title: Long Lost Vibes - Trip to the Moon (throw it back)
htmlContent:
Long Lost Vibes brings the perfect anthem to talk about the new song “Trip to the Moon (throw it back)”. The production brings a fun upbeat sound to set the ultimate tone, to get you invested right way in the artistry that deliver. The singing is masterful in its approach, with the right amount of emotion in approach, that delivers the impressive writing to the fullest to make sure you feel the sound in every way.
